name: Equal Rights
overview: Scripture reveals that God calls for just and impartial treatment of all people, as seen in the command to appoint judges who render fair judgments (Deuteronomy 16:18). The equality of all humans before God is affirmed by the acknowledgment that both rich and poor share the same Creator (Proverbs 22:2) and that God shows no partiality (Romans 2:11). In Christ, distinctions such as ethnicity, social status, and gender are transcended, uniting believers as one body (Romans 10:12; Galatians 3:28), while the call to love extends even to those traditionally seen as enemies (Matthew 5:43).
